title: STILL PRESENT (r1): W8 late-response guard checks the stale detail, not the route — a stale action response still toasts off-route
detail: Guard is detail-presence, not route: navigating detail→dashboard leaves application_detail:Success(stale), so a late ApiReturnedRefcheckAction still matches and toasts on the wrong page. Refetch is route-guarded; the toast is not. Pin test only covers the no-detail case.
recommended_fix: Route-check in ApiReturnedRefcheckAction (or clear application_detail on non-detail routes) and add a test: navigate detail→dashboard with a stale Success detail, then deliver the response — expect no toast.

title: W9 fix unpinned: no test asserts the RC4.3 panel state resets on route change
evidence:
refcheck_menu_open: None,
            refcheck_confirm: None,
            refcheck_edit: None,
            refcheck_action_inflight: set.new(),
// the only route-change refcheck test: refcheck_route_change_resets_expanded_rows_test — asserts only refcheck_expanded / refcheck_explainer_open / refcheck_auto_expanded
detail: The r1 W9 fix (typed-PII-carrying edit/menu/confirm state must not leak across applicants) is implemented but has zero test coverage — a regression would silently reintroduce the leak.
recommended_fix: Extend refcheck_route_change_resets_expanded_rows_test (or add one) asserting refcheck_menu_open, refcheck_confirm, refcheck_edit, and refcheck_action_inflight are all cleared on BrowserChangedUrl to a new applicant.

title: Taken-over unreachable row renders the substitute affordance alongside the takeover surface
detail: After takeover of an unreachable row the panel shows 'You're handling this one' + chips + export AND the 'Substitute referee' button; the hook (compute_hooks/refine_take_over_hook) refines only can_take_over, and substitute_reference_call.sql guards only on status — §7.7 says takeover replaces the row's action area, and the panel's own menu logic agrees.
recommended_fix: Gate view_substitute_surface on not-taken-over (or refine can_substitute_referee by taken_over_at server-side) and add a panel test for a taken-over unreachable row's rendered surface.

title: STILL PRESENT (r1): N13 client half — the client's ?slot= wire format has no test
detail: The server 400 branch is now pinned (start_with_invalid_slot_returns_400_test), but no client test asserts start_check builds ?slot=<slot> / omits the query for slot:None — a wire-format regression would be silent.
recommended_fix: Extract the URL construction for a pure unit test, or add a route-level client test asserting the ?slot= request on per-row start.

title: Wrong-person exhaustion leg pins status+audit but not the in-app notification
detail: Lens guard 4 wants audit + in-app notification handler-tested at both routes. The wrong-person leg omits the notification assert although form_handler.exhaust_wrong_person does notify (notification_dispatch.notify_reference_correction_exhausted).
recommended_fix: Add notification_count(db, call_id) == 1 (and a body containing the corrected referee name) to wrong_person_route_exhausts_corrected_row_test.

title: Substitution creation-fraud stamping (r1 N1 fold) is untested
evidence:
trigger.stamp_creation_fraud_for(config, app_uuid, landlord_uuid, vacancy_uuid, [new_id])
// substitute_creates_new_row_and_audits_old_and_new_ids_test asserts rows/trio/audit ids only; fraud_signals is asserted only in the exhaustion tests (610/992/1061)
detail: The r1 N1 fix (substituted rows get the trigger's creation-time fraud screening) is present in code but no test asserts the new row's fraud_signals — a regression in the parity would pass CI silently.
recommended_fix: Assert fraud_signals on the substituted row in substitute_creates_new_row_and_audits_old_and_new_ids_test (e.g. contains the creation-time stamp keys).
